item.title: TopoCellGen: Generating Histopathology Cell Topology with a Diffusion Model
item.author: SSchindler
item.description: [arXiv] TLDR: Very similar to Samirs idea of generating simplified versions (sketches) of a tissue in the first pass. In the case they generated the cell positions in a slide using a diffusion model and regularized the training using a topology derived loss term. Caveat: This will not scale to whole slide images due to computational constraints. Another note: They do not work with point clouds but with pixel grids (images).
